text:
ana.sales: Quick: Prospect asks for BYO-HSM POC checklist — monthly automated rotation, dual-custodian option, proof of non-export, and pen-test permission. Need a single-paragraph summary and runbook bullets.

Tom.engineering: We support BYO-HSM via per-tenant HSM-proxy. Rotation flow is API-driven with staged overlap (recommend 5-10m). Latency: expect a small first-unwrap hit (~single-digit ms) on cache miss.

mira.security: Short sec-blurb: we cannot offer built-in multi-custodian HSM automation. We provide attestation certs, signed rotation records, and a documented ceremony script; PS can implement split-custody if required. We also require attestation on each rotation and signed rotation logs.

kevin.sre: Runbook bullets: preflight whitelist + attestation check; staging dry-run with simulated custodians; prod cutover window (30-60m) with staged traffic 10%->50%->100% and 5m stabilization; rollback = remap to old KEK. Pen-tests allowed in staging with NDA + 5 business days notice.

olga.solutions: Pricing: BYO-HSM POC surcharge ~+20% for ops/attestation packaging. PS for running ceremony billed separately. I'll add acceptance criteria: attestation artifacts + successful staging rotation.

ana.sales: Ops snippet to paste:
```bash
# test TLS client auth to HSM proxy
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key https://hsm-proxy.example-staging.redwood.ai/health --cacert /path/to/attestation_root.pem
# expect: {"status":"ok","attestation_nonce":"<nonce>"}
```

redwood-bot: Uploaded: POC_BYOHSM_Attestation_Pack.pdf

ana.sales: Thanks all 60; I'll send to the prospect and request TPS numbers.
